children: Armada Acquisition II disclosed a $30.0 million issuance of 4.00% convertible senior PIK notes expected to close with the business combination in Q4 2026.
Pubco (Evernorth Holdings) agreed to issue $30.0M aggregate principal of 4.00% Convertible Senior PIK Notes due 2031 to a private purchaser.
The Convertible Notes issuance is conditioned on and expected to occur concurrently with the previously announced business combination closing in Q4 2026.
Registration Statement on Form S-4 has been declared effective; definitive Proxy Statement/Prospectus was mailed to shareholders with an Aug 20, 2026 record date.
Company cautions shareholders to review the Proxy Statement/Prospectus and other SEC filings before voting or making investment decisions.
